summary: SUP Phase-1 Zendesk-grade upgrade — backend 26/26 pytest passed for every new endpoint + regressions; user & admin frontends load and their flows work. One CRITICAL frontend/backend integration bug found in the user 'Edit my report' flow that crashes the React tree.

minor.issue: user_claimed_source is typed as Literal[...] with no '' escape hatch. Frontend sends empty string '' when the select is left on the placeholder option -> 422 literal_error. Recommend accepting '' and coercing to None (or make the field an EmptyStr | Literal[...] union).

sort_map uses only 'last_activity_at' desc. Older seeded tickets may have null last_activity_at (populated on first activity). Not a defect for new tickets but consider $ifNull fallback for legacy rows.

ui_bugs.issue: Saving the edit report form with no source selected sends user_claimed_source='' -> backend returns 422. The catch block then tries to render the validation-error object directly, throwing 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, ctx})' which unmounts the entire /support tree and lands on the generic 500 error page.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend must (a) omit empty string fields when PATCHing, and (b) surface API errors safely (err.response.data.detail[0].msg) rather than rendering the raw object.

action_items: MySupport.jsx `saveEdit`: strip empty-string fields from payload before PATCH (send user_claimed_source only if truthy), and wrap error rendering with String(err?.response?.data?.detail?.[0]?.msg || err.message).
Backend: relax UserEditTicket.user_claimed_source to accept '' as None (defensive) so third-party clients don't hit the same footgun.
Consider adding a data-testid="my-support-error" toast/inline element so error rendering has a stable target and never crashes the tree.
critical_code_review_comments: support.py is now 1826 lines — well past the 700-line file-size guideline. Recommend splitting into support_user.py, support_admin.py, support_defects.py, support_macros.py + shared models.
AdminSupport.jsx 1142 lines — also over the 700-line guideline. Split AdminSupport / AdminSupportDetail / AdminSupportMacros into separate files.

PATCH /admin/support/tickets/{id}: tags input is silently lower-cased+trimmed; not documented in the response. Consider echoing back the normalised tag list so the UI doesn't need to re-fetch to see 'BILLING' -> 'billing'.

admin_bulk_action: raises 400 mid-loop if value invalid — some tickets may already have been updated before the exception is thrown. Validate `body.value` once BEFORE the ticket loop for set_priority / set_status.
close_my_ticket / reopen_my_ticket both parse ISO strings with .replace('Z', '+00:00') — works but consider datetime.fromisoformat directly if strings are already offset-aware.
PATCH /support/tickets/{id}: `Literal[...]` field with no explicit '' handling; every ticketing API should be defensive for form-submitted empty strings. See action item above.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (admin flow fully works; user flow works except the edit-save crash on empty source)

seed_data_creation: None new. Used the 3 pre-seeded tickets. Bulk-action test set some tickets priority=high; a temporary TEST tag was added-then-removed. Test macro 'TEST Phase1 Macro' created and deleted within test lifecycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green — /app/backend/tests/test_sup_phase1_zendesk.py runs in ~8s and covers every new endpoint (list stats, edit report+409, close+reopen+409, admin list/stats/admins/export CSV/patch priority/patch tags/patch assignee/bulk-5-actions/timeline/macros CRUD) plus regressions (admin detail, admin reply, admin status). Load /app/backend/.env before importing security_utils (already done in test file). For admin UI E2E, use POST /api/admin/auth/login then /api/admin/auth/2fa/verify with pyotp code from decrypt_totp_secret(users.totp_secret) and inject the resulting token into localStorage['wayly_admin_token'] to bypass the 2FA challenge in Playwright. The critical frontend bug is in MySupport.jsx line ~422 (saveEdit) — sends empty '' for user_claimed_source; renders error object directly.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: Log in as trial30909@example.com. Open a 'received' ticket. Click 'Edit my report'. Change the note text (leave 'Where you are getting that from' at placeholder). Click 'Save changes'. Root cause: the initial editForm sets user_claimed_source: (ticket.user_claimed_source || '') and the field is spread whole into the PATCH body. Because the backend Pydantic Literal only accepts a fixed set of strings or omission, '' fails with 422. The frontend's catch block then renders err.response.data.detail (an array of Pydantic validation-error objects) directly as JSX, breaking React's tree and unmounting the app to the generic 500 page. Two-line fix: (1) filter empty strings from payload before PATCH; (2) render String(err?.response?.data?.detail?.[0]?.msg || err.message) inside the toast instead of the raw object.
